# lib3mf

BrickSuite fetches lib3mf v2.5.0 at commit
`64bb454d1fcb53effa57d3cef752a10d740d41a2` during CMake configuration.
It is built statically with its pinned bundled dependencies and is isolated
behind `ThreeMfWriter`; no lib3mf types are exposed to the UI.

lib3mf is BSD-2-Clause licensed. See the staged `deployment/licenses/lib3mf/LICENSE`.
